about: Artifact Hub (artifacthub.io) is the CNCF hub for cloud-native packages such as Helm charts, operators, kubectl/krew plugins and policies. This CLI searches packages and reads package details, versions, default values, templates, changelogs, security reports, views, stars, RSS feeds and site statistics through the public /api/v1 API.

commands.summary: Search Artifact Hub packages by keyword, with filters for kind, category, publisher, repo, org and license, plus sorting and offset paging.

params.name: query
params.description: Full-text search terms, e.g. 'nginx'. Words separated by ' or ' run an OR search, which the site uses for related packages.

params.name: kind
params.description: Package kind id: 0=Helm chart, 1=Falco rules, 2=OPA policies, 3=OLM operator, 4=Tinkerbell action, 5=kubectl/krew plugin, 6=Helm plugin, 7=Tekton task, 8=KEDA scaler, 9=CoreDNS plugin, 10=Keptn integr

params.name: category
params.description: Category id: 1=AI/Machine learning, 2=Database, 3=Integration and delivery, 4=Monitoring and logging, 5=Networking, 6=Security, 7=Storage, 8=Streaming and messaging

params.name: license
params.description: SPDX license id, e.g. Apache-2.0, MIT

params.name: repo
params.description: Repository name to restrict to, e.g. bitnami

params.name: facets
params.description: Also return facet counts (kinds, categories, orgs, repos, licenses)

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (max 60) (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)
